beats.narration: When I was eight, I wanted to be a scientist. Mom got excited and seemed proud. I did not talk much, wore sunglasses everywhere, and battled Yugioh cards with my brother and sister.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Shy childhood wonder held by maternal pride.

beats.narration: At seventeen, my license was my first taste of freedom. My 2000 Honda Accord Coupe had faded paint and no A/C. I installed a radio aux cable converter to play our tunes with friends.

I doubled up to graduate early from Mckinney Boyd High School, earned certifications in Python and Ruby on Rails at coding bootcamp, and at nineteen got my first software engineering job living at home.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Determined pride in early arrival and self-reliance.

beats.narration: I met my wife on a Muslim dating app, Dallas to Chicago. Every week at eight she was on FaceTime and I fell in love. Mia, I love you when I do not show it.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Steady devotion and reassurance to Mia.
